title: Part 4 會議與職場公告
summary: 聽會議裡的公告：發生什麼事、要大家做什麼。

steps.title: 重點觀念
body: 職場公告通常在會議開頭：Good morning, everyone. I have an announcement.
必考：會發生什麼事（What will happen…?）、聽眾要做什麼（What are listeners asked to do?）、某個人是誰（Who is…?）。

steps.title: 解題技巧

head: 類型
開頭常聽到
常考
rows: Please… / Please let me know by…

steps.tip: fifteen（15）和 fifty（50）很容易聽錯：fifteen 重音在後面，fifty 重音在前面。

items.en: Our new computer system will be installed this Friday.
items.zh: 我們新的電腦系統這星期五會安裝。

items.en: Please save all your files before noon.
items.zh: 請在中午前儲存所有檔案。
銷售額上升了百分之十五。

items.en: Please let me know by Monday.

逐字稿：Good morning, everyone. Before we start, I have an announcement. Our new computer system will be installed this Friday.
